title: Helping Families Put Food On The Table This Holiday Season
summary: Free delivery for more than 300 Project DASH partners and a new way for customers to give back will help ensure no family goes without a holiday meal.
body_markdown:
-


Delivering 2 million+ meals for free by waiving delivery fees for more than 300 Project DASH food bank and pantry partners from November 16 through December 25.


-


Launching a customer donation feature in partnership with Feeding America®, giving customers a simple way to support food access directly in the DoorDash app.


-


Working with our grocery partners to help make sure SNAP/EBT users can use benefits to stretch their budget further during the holidays


The holidays are about gathering around the table: the shared meal, the dish handed down through generations, the chair pulled up for one more. But this year, across the country, more people are bracing for difficulty getting food. Nearly[48 million Americans](https://www.feedingamerica.org/hunger-in-america) , including 14 million children, experienced food insecurity, according to Feeding America’s most recent estimates. In a year where things have felt more expensive for everyone, the need is only continuing to grow.


Now food banks and pantries are being asked to do more with less, and many of the families they serve – including seniors, people with disabilities, and those without reliable transportation – can't get to a distribution site on their own.


> “At Emergency Food Network (EFN), we have been managing a growing wait list of over 750 people that are interested in signing up for our bi-weekly home delivery program,” **said Sam Walker, EFN Director of Programs in Tacoma, WA** . “We know that even for those who are already in our program, the need for help with groceries is only heightened during the holidays.”


The holidays raise the stakes. For millions of families, this is the time of year when a shared meal matters most and when going without can be hardest to bear. Putting food on the table is the foundation of everything else the season is about.


Fighting hunger has always been core to DoorDash's mission to grow and empower local economies. Through[Project DASH](https://about.doordash.com/en-us/impact/project-dash) , our effort to power delivery on behalf of food banks and pantries, we work with more than 300 partners nationwide and have powered 9 million deliveries of an estimated[150 million meals](https://about.doordash.com/en-us/news/project-dash-150m) . Our partners tell us the need is growing, and that delivery is how they reach the people who are hardest to serve.


Today, DoorDash is launching a campaign to help for the holidays, making sure that everyone in our communities can put food on the table as they gather with loved ones. Here’s what we’re doing:


-


**Delivering 2 million meals for 300+ Project DASH partners nationwide.** DoorDash is waiving fees for eligible nonprofit Project DASH partners – food banks, food pantries, and community organizations – from Thanksgiving through Christmas, equal to an estimated 2 million meals, so partners can plan larger holiday distributions with confidence. We’re grateful to[Crum & Forster](https://www.cfins.com/) and[PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/us/home) for joining alongside us to generously support this initiative.


-


**Launching a customer donation feature with Feeding America®** . Starting November 16, customers can[make a donation](https://www.doordash.com/consumer/gift-cards?store_id=37355510&item_id=1000023342566016) right from the DoorDash app to support the Feeding America network of food banks. 100% of donations go to Feeding America.


-


**Showcasing opportunities to save with SNAP** . We know that SNAP is one of the most effective tools in combating hunger, so we’re working with our Project DASH partners to share information about how customers can use their SNAP/EBT benefits to save this holiday season with special offerings from our grocery partners.


> “No family should have to wonder how they'll put a holiday meal on the table,” said **Max Rettig, Global Head of Public Policy at DoorDash** . “Food banks and pantries are the lifeline for millions of people, and delivery is how they reach the neighbors who can't reach them. We're proud to stand with our Project DASH partners this season and invite our customers to join us."


## Join Us


We can all agree: no one should go without a meal, especially at the holidays, and the fight against hunger is one in which everyone can play a part.


For individuals. Give through the DoorDash app to support the Feeding America network, or[find your local food bank](https://www.feedingamerica.org/find-your-local-foodbank) if you’re in need.


For food banks and pantries. If you are interested in partnering with Project DASH to deliver food from your facility to the homes of neighbors in need, contact projectdash@doordash.com.
